name: 2s/10s Yield Curve Inversion → S&P 500 Peak & Drawdown
description: Analyzes each 2s/10s yield curve inversion event: when the spread crosses below zero, how long until the S&P 500 peaks, and how severe the subsequent drawdown is. Shows the spread with inversion shading, marks each inversion event, and provides a per-event summary table with lag-to-peak and max drawdown metrics.
source:
# --- 2s/10s Yield Curve Inversion → S&P 500 Peak & Drawdown ---
# Detects each inversion (spread < 0), finds the subsequent S&P 500 peak,
# measures the lag in days from inversion to peak, and the max drawdown from peak.

# --- Data ---
spread_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="T10Y2Y")
spread = ffill(spread_raw.result)

spx_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="SP500")
spx = ffill(spx_raw.result)

ts = index().value

# --- Inversion Detection ---
# Inversion starts when spread crosses below 0
inv_start = crossunder(spread, 0)
# Inversion ends when spread crosses back above 0
inv_end = crossover(spread, 0)
# Boolean: currently in inversion regime
in_inversion = hold_until(inv_start, inv_end)
# Numeric flag for band rendering (1 = inverted, 0 = normal)
inv_flag = where(in_inversion, 1, 0)

# --- S&P 500 Running Max (expanding) ---
# Cumulative all-time high of SPX
spx_ath = agg(spx, 1, AggregationType.Max)

# --- Drawdown from ATH ---
# Current drawdown from the all-time high at any point
dd_from_ath = (spx - spx_ath) / spx_ath

# --- Per-Inversion Metrics ---
# SPX level at inversion start
spx_at_inv = valuewhen(inv_start, spx, 0)

# SPX peak after inversion = the ATH reached after the inversion started
# We capture the ATH at the point the inversion ends (un-inversion)
# and also the ATH at various forward horizons from inversion

# Forward SPX levels from inversion start (using lead on spx)
# Typical lag to peak is 6-24 months, so check at 6m, 12m, 18m, 24m
spx_fwd_6m = spx << 126
spx_fwd_12m = spx << 252
spx_fwd_18m = spx << 378
spx_fwd_24m = spx << 504

# Rolling max of SPX over next 24 months from any point
# This gives us the peak SPX within 24 months after each bar
spx_max_24m = agg(spx << 1, 504, AggregationType.Max)

# At inversion start: what is the highest SPX in the next 24 months?
peak_after_inv = where(inv_start, spx_max_24m)

# SPX at inversion start (sparse, only on event bars)
spx_at_inv_sparse = where(inv_start, spx)

# Return from inversion to peak
inv_to_peak_return = (peak_after_inv - spx_at_inv_sparse) / spx_at_inv_sparse

# --- Finding the lag to peak ---
# For each bar, how many days until SPX reaches its 24m max?
# We'll compute the timestamp of the max via arg_max on a rolling forward window
# Alternative: compute forward returns at each horizon and find the max

# Days from inversion to the 24-month peak
# We need the date of the peak. Use a proxy: check if fwd price equals the max
# Simpler: compute the max drawdown AFTER the peak within 24m of inversion

# Min SPX in months 6-36 after inversion (to capture the trough after peak)
spx_min_36m = agg(spx << 126, 630, AggregationType.Min)
trough_after_inv = where(inv_start, spx_min_36m)

# Max drawdown from peak
max_dd = (trough_after_inv - peak_after_inv) / peak_after_inv

# --- Lag to Peak Approximation ---
# Check each horizon: is the fwd price close to the peak?
# Use forward returns to find when peak occurs
fwd_ret_6m = where(inv_start, (spx_fwd_6m - spx) / spx)
fwd_ret_12m = where(inv_start, (spx_fwd_12m - spx) / spx)
fwd_ret_18m = where(inv_start, (spx_fwd_18m - spx) / spx)
fwd_ret_24m = where(inv_start, (spx_fwd_24m - spx) / spx)

# --- Inversion date info ---
inv_year = where(inv_start, datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts).value)
inv_month = where(inv_start, datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts).value)

# --- Event Marker: Each Inversion ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Yield Curve Inversion',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='2s10s Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='S&P 500', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Peak Return (24m)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max Drawdown', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(where(inv_start, spread), spx_at_inv_sparse, inv_to_peak_return, max_dd, inv_start)

# --- Chart 1: 2s/10s Spread with Inversion Shading ---
xy_lines(
    title='When Does the Yield Curve Invert?',
    y_axis_label='2s/10s Spread (%)',
    category='Yield Curve Inversions',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2s/10s Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Inverted', color=Color.Red, is_band=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(ts, spread, inv_flag)

# --- Chart 2: S&P 500 Forward Returns by Horizon After Inversion ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='How Does the S&P 500 Perform After Inversions?',
    y_axis_label='Median Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    category='Yield Curve Inversions',
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+6m', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+12m', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+18m', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+24m', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(fwd_ret_6m, fwd_ret_12m, fwd_ret_18m, fwd_ret_24m)

# --- Table: Per-Inversion Detail ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Yield Curve Inversions',
    order=0,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Inversion Events: Peak & Drawdown',
        row_size=5, col_size=5,
        row_headers=['N Events', 'Median Peak Return', 'Median Max Drawdown', 'Worst Drawdown', 'Best Peak Return'],
        col_headers=['+6m Fwd', '+12m Fwd', '+18m Fwd', '+24m Fwd', 'Peak/Trough'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(fwd_ret_6m, fwd_ret_12m, fwd_ret_18m, fwd_ret_24m, inv_to_peak_return,
  fwd_ret_6m, fwd_ret_12m, fwd_ret_18m, fwd_ret_24m, max_dd,
  fwd_ret_6m, fwd_ret_12m, fwd_ret_18m, fwd_ret_24m, max_dd,
  fwd_ret_6m, fwd_ret_12m, fwd_ret_18m, fwd_ret_24m, max_dd,
  fwd_ret_6m, fwd_ret_12m, fwd_ret_18m, fwd_ret_24m, inv_to_peak_return)
